title: Eder
summary: Flock. (1.) A city in the south of Judah, on the border of Idumea (Josh. 15:21).

inlines.v: Flock. (1.) A city in the south of Judah, on the border of Idumea (Josh. 15:21).
(2.) The second of the three sons of Mushi, of the family of Merari, appointed to the Levitical office (1 Chr. 23:23; 24:30).
